title: How should extended guidebooks be routed and when is a broader library justified?
question: How should extended guidebooks be routed and when is a broader library justified?
answer:
V3-23B: Root RUNBOOK.md remains the authoritative index; AGENTS.md may approve bounded subordinate guidebooks when a procedure genuinely needs one.
V3-23C: Defer a general guidebook reorganization. This release updates the existing Genesis, Adoption, upgrade, skill, and Runbook instructions and adds only a task-sized guide when required for immediate usability. The owner later placed it in the backlog after v4.
